In mathematics, the '''Coble variety''' is the [[moduli space]] of ordered sets of 6 points in the [[projective plane]], and can be represented as a double cover of the projective 4-space branched over the [[Igusa quartic]]. It is a 4-dimensional [[Variety (universal algebra)|variety]] that was first studied by [[Arthur Byron Coble]].
